Lead the consolidation of two Salesforce instances and two HubSpot portals into a single source of truth. Govern the HubSpot | Salesforce sync, third-party data feeds (LeadGenAI, CourtLink, ZoomInfo, event sources), and the broader revenue tech stack. Evaluate and integrate tooling that improves seller productivity, pipeline visibility, and customer intelligence. **Enablement and adoption.** Stand up the sales enablement function including Salesforce certification and training, playbooks by buyer type, onboarding curriculum, and CRM adoption analytics. Partner with the Pricing and Deal Desk team in Finance on enablement curriculum covering pricing methodology, deal desk workflow, and approval routing. **Cross-functional partnership.** Serve as the operational bridge between Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Client Success. Partner with Marketing on lead funnel analytics, campaign ROI, and demand generation efficiency. Partner with Finance on the rolling forecast, comp plan design, deal economics, and the Pricing and Deal Desk function that lives within Finance. Recruit and develop RevOps talent aligned to KLDiscovery’s growth trajectory. Demonstrated success owning forecast, pipeline, and sales process at the enterprise level. **Industry.** eDiscovery, legal technology, or legal services experience is strongly preferred.
